installment_rate_pct.description: Installment rate as % of disposable income, coded 1-4 by the dataset (1 = lowest band, 4 = highest band)

existing_credits.description: Number of existing credits at this bank, coded 1-4 (4 = four or more)

allowed_values.200_dm_or_more: checking balance >= 200 DM / salary assignments for at least 1 year

allowed_values.all_paid_at_this_bank: all credits at this bank paid back duly
allowed_values.critical_or_other_credits: critical account / other credits existing (not at this bank)
allowed_values.existing_paid_duly: existing credits paid back duly till now
allowed_values.no_credits_or_all_paid: no credits taken / all credits paid back duly
allowed_values.past_payment_delay: delay in paying off in the past

allowed_values.savings_agreement_or_life_insurance: building society savings agreement / life insurance

allowed_values.bank: other installment plan at a bank

excluded_features.personal_status_sex: Protected attribute (sex) combined with marital status - never used as a model input.
excluded_features.age_years: Protected/demographic attribute (age) - never used as a model input.
excluded_features.foreign_worker: Protected attribute (national origin / migration status) - never used as a model input.
excluded_features.num_dependents: Household composition (family status proxy), not a financial feature - excluded.
excluded_features.telephone: Contact-information indicator, not a financial feature - excluded.
excluded_features.present_residence_years: Residential tenure, not a financial feature and a proxy for age - excluded.

target.name: high_risk
target.definition: 1 = 'bad' credit risk as rated by the original lender (credit_class == 2); 0 = 'good' (credit_class == 1).

labels.low_risk: Pattern resembles applicants the original lender rated 'good' credit risk.
labels.high_risk: Pattern resembles applicants the original lender rated 'bad' credit risk.

target.predicted_probability_meaning: Model-estimated probability of the high_risk class (not calibrated to any real population).

notes: All required features must be supplied; the tool never imputes missing values.
Numeric values outside [min, max] are rejected; values outside [training_min, training_max] are accepted with an extrapolation warning.
Amounts are in 1970s Deutsche Mark as recorded in the dataset; they are not convertible to present-day currency in any meaningful way.
